question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: EXCULPATE
solution: The correct answer is '3' i.e. Exonerate . [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **‘Exculpate’** means to show or declare that someone is not guilty of wrongdoing. • Among the given options: • **Condemn:** To express complete disapproval of, typically in public; opposite in meaning. • **Blame:** Assign responsibility for a fault or wrong; opposite in context. • **Exonerate:** To officially absolve someone from blame; synonym to the given word. • **Punish:** Inflict a penalty for an offense; opposite in context. • Thus, the most appropriate synonym for **‘Exculpate’** is **‘Exonerate’**. Correct sentence: *The correct synonym for ‘Exculpate’ is **Exonerate**, which means to clear someone from blame or wrongdoing.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Synonyms:** Synonyms are words or phrases that mean exactly or nearly the same as another word or phrase in the same language. • **Examples of Synonyms:** • **Happy:** Joyful, Cheerful • **Sad:** Unhappy, Melancholy • When solving synonym-based questions, understanding the context and nuances of the word is essential for selecting the correct option. 49:T91f,
